name: Key facts
summary: The facts about one thing as label and value rows, with a short note where it helps and a status colour on values that are a status.
use: to give the details of one booking, order, place or product at a glance
states: status value (success, warning, danger, info, accent)
label over value on a phone
a11y: A description list, so each value is read with its label; a status is said in the value's words, and its colour and dot only repeat it.

use_when: the person asks for the details of one thing: a flight, a parcel, an apartment, a plan
avoid_when: several things side by side: use comparison
two to four headline numbers for a period: use kpi-strip
a step-by-step status over time: use progress-status

parts.name: title
parts.what: the thing the facts are about

parts.name: subtitle
parts.what: one line that places it: where, when or which

parts.name: facts
parts.what: one fact: a label, its value and an optional note

parts.name: value
parts.what: the value, coloured only when it is a status

parts.name: tone
parts.what: the value's status colour: neutral unless it is a status

parts.name: note
parts.what: a short line of context under the value

empty.how: with no facts, answer in plain text instead; a fact without a value shows a dash

loading.how: the renderer keeps the rows and fills label and value with muted blocks

error.how: a fact that could not load shows a dash, and the note says why with tone danger

disabled.how: the part has no controls, so there is no disabled state

overflow.how: up to ten rows stack in the card; on a phone each label sits over its value

long_text.how: labels, values and notes wrap in their column, and long words break
